catalysts.headline: Q3 2026 results: revenue $26.70M (down ~62.8% YoY), loss of $0.22 per share, reported as beating consensus estimates

Cipher Digital reported Q3 2026 results: revenue $26.7M (down ~62.8% YoY from ~$71.7M in Q3 2025, missing a ~$39.3M consensus); GAAP diluted EPS -$0.22 (beat -$0.25/-$0.26 consensus by ~$0.04); net income $31.6M, driven by a $127.2M non-cash warrant-revaluation gain (vs. a $3.28M net loss a year earlier); adjusted EBITDA -$10M. First HPC lease revenue recognized from the Black Pearl campus. Odessa site produced ~296 BTC (207MW capacity, ~17.2 J/TH fleet efficiency); sold 632 BTC for $45.5M (realized gain ~$0.5M). Company now cites 3 contracted HPC campuses totaling 700MW and ~$16.6B of contracted revenue, after amending the Barber Lake lease (extended term, added an AI lab as a direct tenant) to lift that site's own contracted revenue to ~$9.1B. Pro forma unrestricted cash ~$724M as of 2026-09-30.
catalysts.impact: Stock rose on the print; magnitude disputed across sources -- see conflicts

catalysts.headline: Announced a plan to sell $850M of 0% convertible senior notes due 2032 (initial conversion price $15.31/share, with a 13-day greenshoe for an additional $150M); priced the notes 2026-10-14 while concurrently exchanging roughly $166M of its existing 2030 convertible notes for about 41M shares of common stock. Proceeds earmarked partly for capped-call transactions (to limit dilution) and partly for the Barber Lake project and HPC pipeline build-out.
catalysts.impact: Stock fell sharply on the announcement — reported as its worst session in six months, with one source citing an ~18% single-day decline
